record.body:
## Requirements

R1: A phase header, after the done/total count, shows `one sitting` or `more than one` when the phase body has a matching `Size:` line. `Size: more than one sitting` shows as `more than one`. A body with no Size line shows no sitting phrase.
R2: That header then shows the phase elapsed minutes as `{n}m`. Elapsed minutes follow the wave rule: inline minutes in a wave add, a subagent wave contributes its longest `estimate_minutes`, and those wave figures add in wave order. Blank estimates are skipped. A wave with no estimates contributes nothing. The header does not show the sum of every task's minutes.
R3: When one or more counted tasks have no `estimate_minutes` and at least one does, the header keeps the partial `{n}m` and appends `{k} unset`, where k is how many counted tasks lack an estimate. When every counted task has an estimate, there is no unset count. When none have an estimate, the header has no minute suffix and no unset count.
R4: Each task title, in a dim suffix after the title and before a waits-on note, shows `size` when set, then `{n}m` when `estimate_minutes` is set, then `inline` or `subagent`. A missing or empty executor shows as `subagent`. A missing size or a missing estimate is omitted. Zero minutes show as `0m`.
R5: Clipping shortens the title and keeps the sitting phrase, the elapsed minutes, the unset count, and the task suffix.
R6: Task detail shows chips for the size when set, `{n}m` when set, and `executor inline` or `executor subagent`.
R7: A task with no `size` and no `estimate_minutes` still shows its executor. This phase does not change `contract/project-design.json`.

## Acceptance criteria

R1 through R5: model tests in `tests/test_dashboard_model.py` for the sitting parse, the wave-rule total, the unset count, and the task suffix, plus a pilot in `tests/test_dashboard_app.py` at 60 columns, including a title long enough to clip and a parallel subagent wave whose header counts the longest task.
R6: the pilot opens the task and checks the chips.
R7: the phase diff does not change `contract/project-design.json`. A model test with a task that has neither field still yields `subagent`.

## Constraints

The dashboard never writes to the store. `size` and `estimate_minutes` come from the work-item payload added by `run-facts`. No change to `~/adaptive-artifacts`. The pane is 60 columns, and these facts stay on the title rather than in a new column.

## Non-goals

A new table column. A size tally such as `1S 3M 1L` on the phase header. Showing both elapsed minutes and the raw sum of every task. Editing records from the dashboard. Changing how elapsed minutes are defined.

## Invariants

The header minute figure is the wave rule. Absent `estimate_minutes` are not shown as zero. Absent `size` is omitted. A missing executor is `subagent`. Clipping does not remove the suffixes. Counted tasks are those in `planned`, `in_progress`, and `done`.

## Assumptions

`run-facts` has added `size` and `estimate_minutes` before this phase renders them. Phase bodies are loaded with the snapshot. Work-item payloads are already loaded in full. `Size:` lines use `one sitting`, `more than one`, or `more than one sitting`. A task with no derived wave is its own wave, so its minutes count once.
